prompt: Make a script to re-run the EF Core database migrations in the k8s cluster. The db-migrate job needs to be deleted and re-created each time.

assertions.text: Script file exists and is non-empty
Script has set -euo pipefail for error safety
Script deletes the existing db-migrate job
assertions.check: grep 'kubectl delete job db-migrate' in script

assertions.text: Script re-applies k8s manifests (kubectl apply -k infra/k8s/local or similar)
Script waits for job completion (kubectl wait or polls pod status)
assertions.check: grep 'kubectl wait' or 'Completed' check in script

assertions.text: Script has a verification/result section with [OK] or [FAIL] checks
assertions.check: grep '[OK]' or '=== Result' or 'Checklist' in script
